info.riftverse.xenit_ore: Xenite only occurs around meteorite craters (every 900–1,100 blocks). The crater shows 8–12 exposed ores, with an impact vein of 20–30 ores beneath. Xenite veins sit in the iron band (Y −24 to 56) up to 200 blocks around the crater, thinning out towards the edge. The meteorite locator points the way.
info.riftverse.tin_ore: Tin ore generates across the overworld from Y −24 to 112, as common as in Mekanism. Can be switched off in the config if another mod provides tin.
info.riftverse.fluxkristall_ore: Flux crystal ore is rare in the overworld below Y 0. In the crystal world, flux crystal clusters grow back.
info.riftverse.schrott_haufen: Scrap heaps lie in alien wrecks (rusty hulls, rare in the overworld) and in the scrap world. They drop alien scrap for scrap plates and the recycler.
info.riftverse.meteoritenkern: The meteorite core sits in the centre of every crater.
info.riftverse.gravitit_ore: Gravitite ore only exists in the high-gravity world. Needs a diamond pickaxe.
info.riftverse.nullmaterie_erz: Null matter ore hides in the rare null cores of the Empty World (crying obsidian on top), guarded by vexes. 4–7 ores per core, each gives exactly one null matter. Needs a diamond pickaxe.
info.riftverse.meteoritenpeiler: The needle points to the nearest meteorite crater and turns green inside the xenite zone (200 blocks). Only works in the overworld.
info.riftverse.saeuregel: Fill a glass bottle at an acid spring in the toxic world.
info.riftverse.kurbel_dynamo: Hold right-click with the hand crank: 8 FE/t at tier I. Keeps running briefly after cranking.
info.riftverse.handkurbel: Hold right-click on the garage press or the crank dynamo.
info.riftverse.tonnenreaktor: Burns any item: 40 FE/t at tier I. Every item burns for 50 ticks, scrap twice as long, fuels half their furnace time. Occasionally ejects a useful small part.
info.riftverse.xenit_zelle: Battery with 1 million FE at tier I. Keeps its charge when broken and charges or discharges items. Only supplies consumers, never other storage blocks.
info.riftverse.einspeiser: Accepts FE from any mod and feeds it into the Riftverse grid at tier I.
info.riftverse.ausspeiser: Outputs Riftverse power as regular FE. Other mods' machines never explode.
info.riftverse.kupferkabel: Tier I cable (128 FE/t), 0.5 FE loss per block. Bare cables shock when powered; insulated ones can be dyed, and differently coloured cables do not connect. Right-click with an empty hand shows the sub-network.
info.riftverse.umspanner: Front = high tier. Steps down (up to 4 low-tier packets per tick) or, with a redstone signal, steps up (one high-tier packet). Transformers II and III exist for the higher tiers.
info.riftverse.flux_zelle: Battery with 16 million FE at tier II. The charge glows as a crystal band and is kept when broken.
info.riftverse.chrono_beschleuniger: Back side to the machine: speeds it up 2×, 4× or 8× (100, 400 or 800 FE/t, right-click cycles). Crops grow faster; generators cannot be accelerated.
info.riftverse.biomasse_kessel: 80 FE/t at tier I from biomass pulp or plants. Pulp leaves nutrient serum as a by-product.
info.riftverse.zeitschleifen_solar: 120 FE/t at tier II, even at night – every night tick becomes light debt that is paid back at half output during the day. Needs open sky; rain halves the output.
info.riftverse.fluxkristall_resonator: Flux crystal rods in the grid resonate with their neighbours: 20 FE/t and 4 heat per pulse. Heat sinks remove 12 heat/t, water in the tank gives 1.5× output. Each adjacent resonator chamber (up to 6) adds a column. At 10,000 heat the crystal explodes; redstone switches it off.
info.riftverse.gravitations_pendel: Multiblock 3 × 5 × 3: floor and lid of lab hull, four corner posts, the floatstone core in the middle. 400 FE/t at tier II without fuel; double in high gravity, half in low gravity.
info.riftverse.chrono_speicher: 256 million FE at tier III. Charges at 2,048 FE/t and outputs 8,192 FE/t. Touching units form a cluster (up to 9 × 9 × 9). Keeps its charge when broken.
info.riftverse.materie_rekonfigurator: Material in slot 1, pattern item in slot 2 (not consumed), portal fluid cartridge on the right. Converts within a value tier: earth metals or resources of the T1, T2 and T3 universes. 2,000 FE/t + 50 mB portal fluid.
info.riftverse.klon_tank: Two blocks tall, owned by whoever places it. A clone needs 16 biomass pulp and 4 nutrient serum and grows for 2 minutes. When the owner dies, they wake up in the clone in front of the tank with everything they carried. Without 50 FE/t the clone dies.
info.riftverse.universums_destillator: Insert a filled universe sample and get the resource of its type. One sample lasts 16 runs. 3,500 FE/t.
info.riftverse.rift_kabelknoten: Build in pairs and link with the coupling card (sender first, then receiver). Transfers items, fluids and power across worlds; the receiver outputs power at tier IV. 100 FE/t base load, 5 % loss. Both nodes keep their chunk loaded.
info.riftverse.mikrokosmos_zelle: A civilisation in a jar: every 10 s the inhabitants eat as much food as their tier, every 20 s they build with materials. At 90 % satisfaction they advance a tier (up to 4 = 8,000 FE/t), at 0 % they go on strike. The "Draw" button sets how much power you take.
info.riftverse.parallelzapfer: Multiblock 3 × 3 × 3 of graphite hull with four lightning rods; the space above the controller stays empty. 10,000 FE/t at tier IV for 5 mB portal fluid per tick. Each source lasts 3–5 hours, then realign. Sometimes guardians come through the rift.
info.riftverse.weltenformer: Ring 7 × 7 × 3 of null hull with glass on the sides. 40,000 FE/t + portal fluid concentrate. Essence mode: empty cartridge + inversion shard + 2,000 mB concentrate → world-shaper essence. World mode: two universe samples, pick gravity and hazards, paper → coordinate map of a bred universe.
info.riftverse.singularitaetskern: 100,000 FE/t at tier IV, eats 64 items per second. When hungry it grows and devours its surroundings. Emergency shutdown via button or redstone (one minute cooldown).
info.riftverse.eindaemmungsring: Three rings around the singularity core (each the edge of a 5 × 5 square: horizontal, north-south and east-west; 42 blocks). With the ring in place the core shuts down safely after 5 s of hunger.
info.riftverse.portal_kanone_mk1: Right-click opens a rift into a random T1 universe (250 mB raw portal fluid). With stabilised fluid it also reaches T2 worlds. Return with R or sneak + right-click. Reloads full cartridges from your inventory.
info.riftverse.portal_kanone_mk2: Stabilised fluid or concentrate, 100 mB per shot. With a coordinate map in the other hand it jumps to that universe; with concentrate it randomly reaches T3 worlds too.
info.riftverse.portal_kanone_mk3: Concentrate or essence, 50 mB per shot. Remembers 8 targets (V cycles, sneak + V deletes) and opens short-range portals up to 96 blocks. With essence it randomly reaches the Empty World.
info.riftverse.portal_kanone_mk4: World-shaper essence only, 25 mB per shot. Reaches the Empty World and bred universes.
info.riftverse.fluid_kartusche: Fill in the fluid mixer or the refinery. Raw portal fluid decays 10 minutes after it is made – fill it right before you jump.
info.riftverse.universe_scanner: Shows type, laws of nature and modifiers of the universe and whether it is anchored.
info.riftverse.rift_anker: Keeps a universe: it is never reset by the cleanup.
info.riftverse.garagen_hammer: Tool for the hammer slot of the garage workbench. Recipes cost durability.
info.riftverse.loetkolben: Tool for the garage workbench: with solder in the slot next to it, the T1 machines can be soldered.
info.riftverse.universumsprobe: Build it empty and right-click in a universe to capture its signature. The dimension scanner turns it into a coordinate map, the universe distiller extracts resources.
info.riftverse.koordinatenkarte: Hold it in the other hand and fire a gun of Mk II or higher: the rift leads straight into that universe.
info.riftverse.einzweck_drohne: Sneak + right-click into the air switches the task: collect (radius 8, 2 FE/t), hand over (stack from your off-hand to a player or into a chest) or sort (orders a chest by name). 5,000 FE.
info.riftverse.holo_koeder: Projects a hologram of you; mobs attack it for 10 s. 2,000 FE per use.
info.riftverse.schrumpfstrahler: Each hit halves the size (1 → 0.5 → 0.25), the next one resets it. Without a target you hit yourself; sneaking resets immediately. 2,000 FE per shot.
info.riftverse.anti_grav_granate: Throw it: mobs within 6 blocks float for 8 s.
info.riftverse.uebersetzer_halsband: Put it on one of your tamed animals: it talks, collects items, warns about enemies and comments on the situation. 2 FE per second. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand removes it.
info.riftverse.erinnerungsphiole: Sneak + right-click stores your location, drinking takes you back there. Filled vials can be passed on.
info.riftverse.tarn_detektor: Right-click switches it on: invisible and cloaked creatures within 24 blocks start to glow. 1,000 FE per second.
info.riftverse.multiversal_multitool: Modes: drill (pickaxe, shovel, axe and hoe; 50 FE per block), wrench (rotates machines; sneaking removes chips first, then the machine with its contents) and scanner.
info.riftverse.multitool_mk: Better mining level (diamond, netherite) and a bigger battery: Mk II 500,000 FE, Mk III 2 million FE.
info.riftverse.zeitstopper: Freezes mobs and projectiles within 12 blocks for 6 s. 40,000 FE per use.
info.riftverse.mutagen_spritze: Right-click a mob: random mutation (size, speed or ability). 10 % risk of a botched mutation – bigger, tougher, stronger, with special loot.
info.riftverse.aufgaben_box: Right-click an ore: the helper mines the whole vein (up to 64 blocks). On a field: harvests and replants within 8 blocks. Into the air: fights. After 5 minutes it falls apart.
info.riftverse.ruestung: Multiversal armour has no durability, it runs on FE. Blank in the precision assembler, calibrated in the quantum lithograph, perfected in the rift forge; modules, charge and chest tank carry over. Set bonus "Multiversal Resonance": all four pieces perfected and a universe core in the core mantle.
info.riftverse.modul: Install at the garage workbench together with the matching armour piece. To remove, put the piece alone into the workbench – the last installed module stays in the grid. The armour battery pays the running costs.
info.riftverse.chip: Right-click a processing machine from T1 onwards to install the chip (one of each kind). Remove with the multitool in wrench mode and sneak + right-click.
